title: Choose the visual world for PC Pro Inspections
question: The roll assigned the Legion Hall Notice Wall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Legion Hall Notice Wall
options.lineage: county-seat American Legion / VFW hall: bunting, painted enamel sign, typed notices, brass tacks
options.thesis: The business posts its prices and its phone number on the wall where Fairfield already reads them.
options.viewport: Red-and-white bunting swag (the waving flag canvas, clipped to a scalloped band) across the top; below it a painted navy wall carrying one enamel sign 'PC PRO INSPECTIONS · Fairfield, Ill.' and one large typed notice: HOME INSPECTIONS, PRICES POSTED, the six sqft price bands in tabular figures, and the phone number painted as the primary action. 'Get my price' is the secondary. No hero photo.
options.risk: Executed photoreal it becomes a 2009 cork-board skeuomorph; it only works flat, graphic, sign-painter quality.

raised.raise: Three dyes only carry the whole page: navy, red, bone. Brass is reserved for tack heads and rules.
One compositional law: everything hangs on the wall's tack grid, including nav, forms, and footer.
States are printed marks: pressed = filled, disabled = struck through, focus = bracketed. No radius anywhere except tack heads.
Red is spent on one moving thing per viewport: the phone number, then the price the calculator lands on.

options.label: The Report Itself
options.lineage: the Spectora inspection report the buyer will receive that evening
options.thesis: The website is built as the inspection report, so the buyer has already read one before they call.
options.viewport: Report cover: 'Inspection Report · PC Pro Inspections' with a summary block of three counts (Safety / Repair / Maintenance) drawn from a real sample, the price for the buyer's square footage as finding 1.1, and the inspector's phone as the sign-off. Every page of the site is a report section with a running header and page number.
options.risk: Reads as software or a document viewer if the type and rules go generic; it is also the direction with the least room for the flag.

options.label: Hardware-Store Seed Rack
options.lineage: spring seed-packet rack at the farm and hardware store
options.thesis: Each service is a packet: a painted promise on the front, the price and instructions in tiny type on the back.
options.viewport: A galvanized rack of packets: Standard Inspection, Termite, Crawl Space (the Wombat), Thermal, Mold, Pool. The front card flips to its price band and what is included. Phone number stenciled on the rack header.
options.case: Rural buyers know this rack by heart, so identification is strong; clarity loses narrowly because prices hide behind a flip.
options.risk: Charming on the Services page, thin on About, Reviews, and legal pages.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Content rides a roll of dyed-cloth courses stepping under one window.
options.viewport: A cloth roll stepping price bands under a window.
options.case: Southern Illinois buyers do not identify with British depot blinds; clarity suffers from one-size caps.

options.label: Collider Event Display
options.thesis: One frozen event, tracks curving through concentric rings.
options.viewport: The house as a concentric cross-section.
options.case: No buyer identifies with a detector; clarity collapses under the metaphor.
options.kept: One compositional law governs every section.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Page
options.lineage: scholarly wide-margin editions with a rubric key rail
options.thesis: Two dense columns around a vermilion rail of keys.
options.viewport: A ruled reference page with keys in the margin.
options.case: Holds clarity through printed states but a nervous buyer does not identify with a scholarly edition.
options.kept: States as printed marks; no radius; hairlines at one device pixel.

options.label: Crank Paper Menagerie
options.thesis: A procession of cut-paper figures driven by one crank.
options.viewport: A cranked paper house opening its systems.
options.case: Delightful, but a buyer under contract wants a price, not a toy.
options.kept: One red reserved for the thing in motion.

options.label: Chromatophore Skin
options.thesis: A living surface whose pattern is its state.
options.viewport: A surface that ripples with state.
options.case: No identification and no clarity for a home inspection.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a good home-inspector site ships in 2026, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Light page, photo of the inspector, headline, phone + quote buttons, three service cards, reviews, FAQ, footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the next inspector's site by design.
